description: Identify your lifelong Guardian Angel from the classical 72 Kabbalistic Angels (Shem HaMephorash tradition) and your Eastern Patron Bodhisattva (Bát Đại Bản Mệnh Phật) based on your birth date. If full year is provided, calculates exact Lunar calendar year using Lunar New Year (Tết) boundary. Details governing virtues, spiritual strengths, and sacred invocation prayer.

birth_date.description: Birth date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD or month-day MM-DD (e.g. 1990-01-01, 1988-02-15, 08-25)

name: find_guardian_angel
title: Find Guardian Angel & Patron Buddha by Birth Date
